text:
pagerbot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-9071 triggered for service `inference-api-prod` (high error rate). Trigger: 5xx spike > 5% for 3m. Priority: P1. Paging @alice (oncall) primary, fallback policy enabled -> will escalate to `platform-support` if unacked in 2m. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-9071

alice (oncall): acked INC-9071. I'm on it, looking at logs and dashboards now.

bob (sre): wait — I just got the same page in platform-support channel. Was fallback supposed to go there? I thought inference-oncall is the only target.

dave (support): we got pinged in support and have a customer DM open: Ticket #C-4321 reporting intermittent 503s on embeddings endpoint since ~10:01 UTC. We started triage but didn't have infra context.

eve (eng): quick check: dashboard https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/alert-9071 shows error-rate on inference-api-frontend + latency spike, looks like upstream model-serving returning 502s. Could be model pool OOMs.

alice (oncall): timeline: pager fired at 1932468000. I acked at 1932468020. Fallback triggered and forwarded to `platform-support` at 1932468030 — that seems wrong. I didn't get notified in our platform channel because PD payload listed wrong service id `svc-frontend-legacy`.

carol (product): what's customer impact now? support says a handful of customers with failing requests? Are SLAs affected?

dave (support): ~12 customers showing errors in last 15m, highest-traffic tenants hit intermittently. No full outage but degraded. Customer impact = medium; some paid tenants hitting 5xx. Logging ticket updated.

bob (sre): digging into PD routing: looks like a rollback from yesterday changed a service alias in our routing rules. Fallback policy works as designed — it forwarded to the backup escalation which is `platform-support`. But the primary target was wrong.

alice (oncall): can someone re-route the incident to inference-oncall and remove platform-support from the escalation temporarily? I'll keep triage for the service once re-assigned.

eve (eng): I can patch PD via CLI. Running:
```
pd incidents reassignto INC-9071 --service inference-api-prod
pd services update svc-frontend-legacy --escalation_policy ep-inference-oncall
```
Hold on.

bob (sre): FYI the correct command is `pd incident reroute` (CLI flavor varies). Before you change, dump the incident metadata: `pd incidents show INC-9071 --output json`

eve (eng): pasted output: `service.id: svc-frontend-legacy`, `escalation_policy: ep-platform-support-fallback`. I'm reassigning service -> `inference-api-prod` and setting fallback to `inference-oncall-rotation`. Applying now.

pagerbot: Incident INC-9071 reassigned to service `inference-api-prod`. New escalation: `inference-oncall-rotation`. Notifying @alice (oncall) and @bob (sre).

alice (oncall): confirmed I have the incident in our rotation now. @dave please coordinate any customer comms. @eve @bob I'll start collecting logs and metrics and attempt a graceful model pool restart if we confirm OOMs.

dave (support): crafting a short customer-facing status: "We're investigating intermittent 503s for embeddings; mitigation in progress; updates every 15m." Posting to affected tenants and creating follow-up ticket backlog.

bob (sre): quick mitigation plan:
1) check model-serving node OOM / GPU memory pressure
2) if mem pressure high, roll model pool 1 -> restart pods gradually
3) if crash-looping, scale pool down then back up

Logs show repeated `CUDA out of memory` traces on worker c-ml-13 at 10:03 UTC. Starting controlled restart of model pool behind circuit breaker.

alice (oncall): performing rolling restart of model pool-embeddings with 30s drain. Will monitor errors and latency.

pagerbot: INC-9071 status updated: acknowledged by alice (oncall), reassigned, mitigation in progress. Customers notified. Next update due in 12m.

eve (eng): after restart, error rate dropped from 6.7% -> 0.9% over two minutes; latency normalized. I'm leaving the PD fallback policy adjusted to avoid platform-support until we patch the alias.

carol (product): thanks team. Please capture RCA notes — was config drift in PD routing the root cause? Also need customer follow-up template from support.

bob (sre): agreed. Root cause: deploy rollback yesterday accidentally re-pointed service alias `svc-frontend-legacy` in PD. Short-term fix: reassign incident, adjust fallback policy. Long-term: lock escalation policy edits behind review and add a PD config lint in CI.

alice (oncall): incident will remain open for postmortem. I'll add replication steps and timeline to the incident and assign postmortem owner. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:

dave (support): customers updated. Ticket #C-4321 marked: mitigation applied, awaiting confirmation. Closing customer-facing thread after final validation.

pagerbot: INC-9071 closed by alice (oncall) at 1932468920. Final note: misrouted fallback & service alias drift -> address in RCA.
